entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The chief really worked us hard...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Makoto and Yusuke are scheduled for[n]today, huh?
entries.uk: На сьогодні заплановані Макото[n]і Юске, так?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I haven't seen them...[n]What happened to them?
entries.uk: Я їх не бачив...[n]Що з ними сталося?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's see, our plans for today are...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Do we not have anything planned?
